The IMF Executive Board Minutes Dataset is a text corpus of the IMF Executive Board's discussions of individual countries in {{< dataset-value period >}}. It covers {{< dataset-value counts.meetings >}} meetings on {{< dataset-value counts.countries >}} low- and middle-income countries, mostly on lending and economic surveillance, with more than {{< dataset-value counts.words >}} words of comments from Board members. For each meeting, it identifies everyone who attended and gives the full text of each comment from the Board's minutes, with the speaker's position, country, and constituency, and whether the comment was a written statement. The codebook explains how the Executive Board works and defines each variable.
